title: introduce conditional-privilege seeding controller with coordinated-rollback workflow
author: Ava Lin
commits: a1c9b4c: implement conditional seed controller state machine and owner refs
b2d8e21: helm templates for transient rolebindings and sealed-secret apply hook
c3f4a0d: terraform module exports tenant_plan_fingerprint and drift detector
d4e5b6f: preflight script to validate KMS/HSM and network egress; sanitize key identifiers
e5f6a7b: end-to-end test that simulates secret apply failure and asserts rollback behavior
description: Motivation: Private installs must seed tenant RBAC and secrets without leaving elevated privileges if the install fails. This PR adds a controller that applies transient privileges only when preflight checks and plan fingerprints match, and a coordinated rollback path to revoke those privileges and clean up partial resources on failure. Scope includes: a new controller that manages seed lifecycle for tenant CRs, Helm changes to render conditional rolebindings and a pre-seed hook, a Terraform module that emits a deterministic plan fingerprint consumed by the controller, preflight KMS/HSM and network checks, and an orchestrated rollback handler that is idempotent and annotated on the Tenant CR for operator follow-up. Design highlights: principle-of-least-privilege transient ServiceAccounts with TTL annotations and ownerRefs for GC; plan fingerprint validation to prevent drift-based secret injection; exponential backoff and requeue on GC races; observability via events, metrics (tenant_seed_success_total, tenant_seed_rollback_total) and structured logs; feature gated behind installer flag enable_conditional_seed to preserve backward compatibility. Testing: unit tests for controller transitions and sanitizer behavior; integration e2e in CI using KinD + mocked KMS to validate acceptance and failure paths; e2e asserts rollback revokes rolebindings within expected window and annotates the Tenant CR with failure_step and failure_reason. Migration and operator guidance: operators should enable feature in maintenance windows, run terraform plan with the tenant bootstrap module to collect tenant_plan_fingerprint and store it as a TenancyPlan custom resource; docs/privileged-seeding.md includes runbooks and recovery steps. Security notes: logs sanitized to avoid exposing full KMS ARNs, grant windows default to 5 minutes TTL, and a follow-up is tracked to add HSM-backed signing for fingerprints (SUP-1984).
review_thread: Diego Martinez (reviewer): Can we avoid listing raw KMS keys in logs? Please sanitize any key identifiers in logs and ensure we only emit key IDs, not full ARNs.
Ava Lin (author): Good catch — sanitized logs and added a unit test asserting the sanitizer behavior (commit d4e5b6f).
Priya Shah (reviewer): The terraform module outputs need clear names; otherwise automation will misbind. Suggest renaming output 'plan_fingerprint' to 'tenant_plan_fingerprint'.
Ava Lin (author): Renamed outputs and adjusted controller to read tenant_plan_fingerprint (commit c3f4a0d).
Liam O'Connor (reviewer): E2E was flaky on first runs due to race in garbage collection; add a small backoff and requeue in controller delete path.
Ava Lin (author): Added exponential backoff and requeue logic; CI e2e stabilized after change (commit a1c9b4c).
Security team (comment): design approved with follow-up to support HSM-backed signing for plan fingerprints (tracked SUP-1984).
Diego Martinez (approval): LGTM after CI green — merging once two approvals and smoke pass.
merge_outcome: Merged into main after CI green and approvals
release_notes: Add conditional-privilege tenant seeding controller with coordinated atomic rollback. Feature gated behind enable_conditional_seed. Includes terraform module fingerprinting, preflight KMS checks, and improved RBAC hygiene for private installs.
